title: Personal Checking: refund decision in a same-day maintenance fee waiver review
content:
## Scope

This rule combines the waivers judged when an owner questions a Personal Checking monthly maintenance fee dated the current business day, the cycle closing date, and decides whether that fee is refunded as a bank error.

## Formal clauses

1. **Any one waiver.** When the Relationship Balance is at or above the tier's Relationship Balance waiver level, or either ledger waiver (direct deposits or debit card purchases) is met, and the fee has no refund yet, the fee was assessed although a waiver was met and is refunded as a bank error.
2. **Never twice.** A fee that already has a refund entry is never refunded again.
3. **Otherwise.** In every other case this review refunds nothing, and the remaining waivers of the tier and any courtesy request are decided under the general Personal Checking maintenance fee rules and fee refund rules.
4. **No rounding.** Fee amounts carry 2 decimal places, so the refund needs no rounding.

## Truth table

| Relationship Balance at or above the tier's waiver level | Direct deposit waiver met | Purchase-count waiver met | Fee already refunded | This review |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | No | No | Refunds the fee as a bank error |
| No | Yes | No | No | Refunds the fee as a bank error |
| No | No | Yes | No | Refunds the fee as a bank error |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Refunds the fee once, as a bank error |
| No | No | No | No | Refunds nothing |
| Any | Any | Any | Yes | Refunds nothing |

## Boundary (hypothetical level of 6000.00 USD, chosen only for illustration)

| Relationship Balance measured | Compared with 6000.00 | Waiver on this ground |
|---|---|---|
| 6000.00 | At the level | Met |
| 5999.99 | Below | Not met |

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "if none of these waivers is met, the owner's request is refused". **Correct basis:** this review refunds nothing, and the tier's remaining waivers and any courtesy request are then decided under the general maintenance fee and fee refund rules.
- **Wrong reading:** "a fee that was once refunded and questioned again is refunded a second time". **Correct basis:** a fee that already has a refund entry is never refunded again.
